_readme: 'How a project works' steps (SPEC 5.3), reused on Home, About and Work With Us. Steps are based on what SCG says today; officers must confirm details and replace each [TBD].

steps.name: Client request
steps.text: A client submits a request, and SCG scopes it into a Statement of Work (SoW).

steps.name: Team forms
steps.text: Members choose from the semester's projects and teams are formed. [TBD: typical team size and roles]

steps.name: Weekly rhythm
steps.text: Teams meet weekly on their project, alongside general body meetings or workshops.

steps.name: EY guidance
steps.text: Each client team is paired with EY consultants, senior managers and partners for direction.

steps.name: Deliverables
steps.text: The team delivers the items agreed in the SoW. Each project's Scope lists them.

steps.name: Handoff
steps.text: [TBD: how outcomes are presented and handed off to the client]
